environment: A GitHub-hosted runner: a fresh virtual machine on shared Azure hardware, not a dedicated Linux server; other tenants may share the physical host, and the runner label does not fix the CPU model (an earlier run of the same workflow on this label drew a different CPU). The probe was built on the runner (rustc 1.98.1, release profile) from examples/feasibility.rs copied into a crate without the workspace lints, with ort 2.0.0-rc.15 and tokenizers 1.0.0-rc.3 as pinned; the complete backend ran in the crate's release-profile test binary. The checkpoint files were downloaded at the recorded revision and each matched the record's length and SHA-256. The Node binding with local-embed was built in the native matrix target's image (rust:1.98.1-bookworm by digest, GNU libc 2.36) and tested on the runner's Node 22.
